objective: select one whole frozen post-tail arm by the sum of predicted truth probabilities over all 1104 realised seams
control: confirmed selective plus unique-fullres six-arm fusion final layout
training_rows: all 1104 realised right/down seams from every arm; binary label is whether the directed seam occurs in the exact synthetic reference
whole_layout_score: sum of per-relation positive-class probabilities; maximum wins; exact tie retains control

feature_contract.relation_evidence: raw two-sided local ranks, margins, signed best gaps and z-scores; focal membership/logit/provenance; pre/post six-arm support
feature_contract.control_evidence: whether this relation is realised by the frozen control and whether the row belongs to the control arm
feature_contract.arm_identity_justification: the six named arms are fixed solver mechanisms with different calibrated reliability; one-hot identity is inference-visible provenance, not target data
feature_contract.forbidden: aggregate target-derived labels, tile pixels beyond frozen matcher costs, or any reference feature

fit_sequence: fit local32; diagnose in-sample and held32 source-disjoint
if held signal: fit local32+held32; evaluate fresh32 development

development_exposure.fresh32: already opened and historically model-selection-exposed; development evidence only

formal_confirmation.rule: before any generation or scoring, sign an entirely new source-disjoint roster excluding every explicit source used by local32, held32, fresh32, all signed TASKA confirmations, and all model training panels

prohibited_adaptation: feature subset, threshold, depth, leaf, iteration, learning-rate, regularization, class-weight or arm-weight search
layout mixing, relation voting into a new layout, or post-processing
